0022600102.text: The Lakers (1-0, 2nd in the Pacific, 5th in the West) host the Clippers (1-0, 1st in the Pacific, 1st in the West) in the second game of the Lakers' season, with both teams unbeaten so far. The Lakers are without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (out, oblique strain), and Jake LaRavia is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), Max Strus (out, plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery). The teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season, and the 2025-26 series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on February 20, 2026 in Los Angeles, where the Lakers won 125-122.
